targets.behavior: Schema-v4 definitions round-trip and versions 1 through 3 migrate deterministically.
Malformed definitions, missing geometry, invalid routes, and aperture failures are reported deterministically.
Ordered crossings, smooth fairing, crowded spans, and bend-safe Sweep scenarios remain deterministic.
Harness defaults and per-wire material, diameter, appearance, and stripe overrides resolve correctly.
Wire routes, pathway occupancy, connection use, and diagram projections cross-check by stable identity.
Editing, search, collapse state, diagram navigation, diagnostics, and dialog rollback behave at the web boundary.
Fusion creates, persists, rediscovers, previews, and generates the deterministic reference harness.
Every feasible routing fixture produces one native solid Sweep and infeasible fixtures fail preflight.
Preview, clear, save, close, reopen, and clear again leave no cached or orphaned Custom Graphics.
Generate, rebuild, transform, and clear preserve wire identity and keep stripes owned by their generated components.

Every persistent edit, Preview, Generate, Rebuild, and Clear Solids operation creates one reversible Fusion history action with stable Undo/Redo results; transient Clear Preview removes graphics immediately.
Repeated add-in stop and start cycles remove and restore commands, palettes, handlers, previews, and package modules cleanly.
Deleted or invalid profile references survive reload as repairable findings without damaging healthy definitions.
Palette hover and diagram scopes select the intended root-context profiles, gates, and generated wire bodies.
Wire stripes conform to curved solids, remain centered, and retain useful contrast at representative viewpoints.
